contract: Reject exact full-word handle0xffff or any nonconnected result and return8. Connection-state lookup uses the typed uint16 SDK key.
Capture low-byte TX and RX settings before diagnostics; preserve full input words in request logs and full handle in invalid/request logs. Repeated mode reads preserve stock short-circuit behavior.

Execute the pinned S140 sd_ble_gap_phy_update gateway SVC0x8f with uint16 handle and TX/RX bytes in that order. Return the full SDK status; log nonzero failures without invoking the fatal/error handler.
limits: Connection-state, logging and supervisor-call service results are modeled; the actual C policy and S140 SVC instructions execute. No radio or physical connection is exercised.

All scalar results, log calls/arguments, callee-saved integer/FP registers, masks, stack position and guards are compared. Private scratch-register restoration and stack addresses are outside the C contract.

Adds no mutable state or assembly. The broad GAP event writer remains open, so the application import set is unchanged at71. This is a tested lower dependency, not a final firmware link or boot proof.
Byte identity and a paid compiler are not requirements. Global sources-check retains the pre-existing unrelated unlisted G2 resident_rom_thumb_set.S entry.
